title: High-density time-series: canvas fallback, annotation layer, and screen-reader accessible legends
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Large dashboards with dozens of high-frequency time-series (per-second telemetry, high-cardinality signals) currently cause severe frame drops and DOM bloat when rendered as SVG/DOM paths. We need a robust pattern that: 1) uses a canvas fallback for dense renderings, 2) exposes annotations/markers in an accessible way for screen readers and keyboard users, and 3) keeps tooltips/legends interactive and discoverable without re-introducing DOM/perf regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas-based rendering mode is available and automatically selected when series_count > 8 or point_density > threshold
Annotation layer implemented as lightweight DOM overlay that mirrors canvas positions and exposes semantic markup for assistive tech
Legend supports keyboard focus, toggling series visibility, and announces changes via aria-live region
Tooltip hit-testing uses precomputed spatial index to avoid per-frame layout queries; tooltip latency under 30ms on target hardware
Performance budgets met: 60fps sustained on medium dashboards (12 series, 10k points each) with sampling strategy and requestAnimationFrame batching
Unit and e2e tests added (Jest perf mocks, Cypress interaction flows) and accessibility tests (axe) pass with no high/critical violations
Documentation and example snippets added to component library and Console doc page with migration guidance
implementation_notes: Primary plan: keep existing chart API stable; add `renderMode: 'auto'|'canvas'|'svg'` prop with 'auto' deciding by heuristics
Canvas rendering will draw paths to an offscreen canvas for faster compositing; an overlay DOM layer will host interactive hotspots for keyboard/a11y
Annotations stored in a small indexed list with normalized coordinates to allow cheap transforms on resize
Tooltip hit-testing will use an R-tree like spatial index precomputed during data ingestion stage; update only on data/scale change
Use requestAnimationFrame for all animation and batched setState to avoid layout thrash; memoize expensive scale computations
Fallback and telemetry: add runtime metric to Console (renderMode chosen, frame drops, sample rate) to inform future tuning
comments: 2026-01-13 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence. Agreed thresholds: series_count > 8 or avg_points_per_view > 3000 triggers canvas. Action: prototyping is required.
2026-01-20 - Ravi Shah: Prototype shows 3x reduction in paint time with canvas on our internal perf harness. Memory looks good but need to test accessibility overlay approach.

2026-01-28 - Accessibility review (Priya Kaur): Overlay approach OK but ensure annotations have role='note' and include data-summary attribute for succinct announcements. Avoid relying solely on aria-describedby.

2026-02-02 - Design review (Jon Park): Requested tighter legend keyboard flows: left/right arrows to move, space to toggle, and an aria-pressed state. Also requested visual focus ring for high-contrast modes.
2026-02-07 - Engineering sync (link to PR): Implemented spatial index and canvas draw loop. Found an edge case with animated series updates causing stale hotspots — added incremental index updates.

2026-02-10 - QA (Elena Rossi): Started Cypress flows for keyboard legend navigation and tooltip activation. Observed a minor announce latency on VoiceOver macOS; investigating aria-live prioritization and message throttling.
